facts.name: Oak Creek Apartments
facts.address: 1600 Sand Hill Rd, Palo Alto, CA 94304
facts.pet_policy: Dogs and indoor cats allowed (restrictions apply), two (2) pets maximum; a monthly pet fee applies.
facts.lease_terms: A premium of $200 per month applies to new leases and renewals with a duration of less than six to nine months. Lease renewal letters sent at least a month before expiration.
facts.international_or_no_ssn: Stanford affiliate rates are available to those who qualify for eligibility category 1 and category 2. Please see our eligibility page with more information.
facts.notes: Community consists of studios, one and two bedroom apartments. Amenities include a health club, steam rooms, saunas, five heated pools, spa, three tennis courts, clubhouse, and children's playground. Each unit features a patio or balcony. Prices are subject to change and vary by location/floor/amenities. Two dog-friendly parks nearby.
